$comment: cloud-burn v2 task list (2026-11-04). Read by the cloud orchestrator (see cloud-burn/START.md) and passed to .claude/workflows/cloud-burn.js as args.batch. `files` = the ONLY paths a code task may write (new files included). Report/review/mutation/reconcile tasks write NOTHING in the repo themselves: they return markdown, and one scribe per batch commits all of a batch's reports to docs/reports/cloud-burn-2026-11/<id>.md on one docs branch. est_usd = inference (Opus 5.5 ~ $1 per 1M processed tokens, Sonnet 5.5 ~ $0.5; ~90% cache reads assumed), not a measurement. shard: A = code PRs, B = Opus reviews/reports, C = mutation + UI + QA + spec reconciliation. order = priority inside the shard (lower first).

Feed the same inputs (legal, '..', absolute, very long, non-allowlisted chars, trailing newline) to abf_station.rules.path_problem and abf_platform.compute_envs.path_problem and assert equal answers. abf_station is read-only. Extract abf_emit, abf_cap, abf_jq_works, deny, ask bodies from hooks/*.sh, strip comments/blank lines, assert same-named copies are identical; existing differences become explicit, reasoned exceptions inside the test. hooks/ read-only.

Add --chromium-path (default $CHROME_PATH if set) passed as executable_path; exit code 3 contract unchanged when nothing usable exists. Extend the existing script test for the flag (no browser needed for the test).
Ratchet: production .py defs that are AST-identical (docstrings stripped) and same-named in >=2 files fail; today's set goes into the baseline (may only shrink); whitelist main/render with reasons.
Ratchet: same-named shell functions across scripts/**/*.sh; today's set into the baseline; a new duplicate fails.
Header comment only (purpose, how to run, one-off or not) + smoke test: imports and --help do not crash; without playwright it skips loudly with the reason.

Design-only report for backlog item settings-ce-table-mobile: at 390px the settings Compute environments table breaks words mid-letter. Reproduce with ui_check, read web_settings.py and DESIGN.md, propose the card layout under ~640px (CSS/HTML change list, RED test names). Do not edit web*.py (HOT).

Real-process QA walk per .claude/skills/verify-abf/SKILL.md: start platform (web + receiver + MCP), a test fake station (never a real site) and the CLI; walk login, CE list, settings, read-only MCP tools, main CLI subcommands. Each problem: repro command, actual vs expected output. Only record, never fix.

pool.$comment: Never-empty backlog. When a shard has no eligible task left (or finishes early), the orchestrator generates the next items from here, in this order, skipping ids that already have a report on any cb docs branch or in origin/v3:docs/reports/cloud-burn-2026-11/. A shard may borrow from another shard's pool when its own is empty.

reconcile.how: SR<nn>: take the next 6 directories of `git ls-tree -d --name-only origin/v3 specs/` in sorted order not yet covered; for each, compare spec.md/plan.md/test-case.md promises with the current code and tests: every promise -> kept / drifted (file:line) / untested / removed-on-purpose (cite commit). Output one report per batch.

review.how: AR<nn>: every production .py/.sh not yet covered by an AR report, 3-5 files per unit, largest first (git ls-tree -r -l origin/v3 platform scripts).

mutation.how: MU<nn>: next non-test module by size under platform/abf_platform, platform/abf_station, scripts/*.py not yet mutated.

second_opinion.how: AR<nn>b: re-review an AR unit whose report had >=3 surviving findings, with a lens the first pass did not use (concurrency / error paths / i18n strings / Windows paths).
